title: Bundle Pricing Memorandum: Paystride Payroll Card Program and the Per-Worker Fee
content:
A Paystride Payroll Card Program discounts the per-worker fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: where the employer's Payroll Card Program in live status has a launch date on or before the first day of the billing month and is held in the Paystride Paycard Program Premier or Paystride Paycard Program Elite package, the discount is 10 percent; where such a live program has a launch date on or before that day and is held in any other package, the discount is 5 percent; otherwise, including when the employer holds no live Payroll Card Program, there is no card bundle discount.

The facts are read from the employer's Paystride Payroll Card Program record: its status, its launch date and the package it is held in.

| Payroll Card Program record | Launch date | Discount on the per-worker fee |
|---|---|---|
| live, Premier or Elite package | on or before the first day of the billing month | 10 percent |
| live, any other package | on or before the first day of the billing month | 5 percent |
| live, any package | after the first day of the billing month | none |
| not in live status | any | none |
| no Payroll Card Program | none | none |

**Scope beside the platform-fee discount.** The Payroll Card bundle discount on the platform fee applies only to the platform fee, never to per-worker, sponsored, implementation, termination or return fee lines, and an SLA credit for the same month is computed on the discounted fee, except that the per-worker fee, the early termination fee and the base of the service level credit for the latest census month are set by their own provisions, the per-worker fee being set by the per-worker fee provisions.
